name: Launch
description: Problem, product working, call to action. Sixty seconds, silent, built for a feed.
durationComment: 60s is the target and 70s the ceiling: past about 90 seconds each further 10 costs roughly a tenth of the completions, so the cut stays comfortably inside that. The floor exists for the opposite reason — a four-step flow lands near 14s, which gives each caption barely a second, and the captions are the only narration a muted video has.

intro.comment: Runs over the first live screen, never a title card. The stay-or-scroll decision is made in roughly the first 1.7 seconds, so the intro has to end inside that window with the product already on screen — a viewer who sees a logo instead decides this is an advert and leaves.

formatsComment: Three masters from one capture. Landscape is the hero for a landing page and a desktop timeline; vertical is what a phone feed actually gives full attention to; square holds its size in a mobile timeline without the vertical crop. safeBottomRatio keeps the caption out of the band a platform draws its own chrome over.
